# Derived alignment views (generated by SQARMA; NOT STAR3D raw output)

**seed** = ordinary Rfam seed 15.1 correspondence; **STAR3D** = the selected original STAR3D v1.2 output (one forward run) mapped through the residue crosswalk. Residues are row indices (= author numbers for these chains). `-` = no partner. Lower-case = residue without coordinates. The raw STAR3D file is named under each block.
